text: Plan: select an explicitly UNVERIFIED prototype BOM around TPS2065CDBVR, then synchronize BOM, SPEC, SUBSYSTEMS and affected capability specs. First verify installed symbols, real pins and exact footprints. Key risks are condition-limited idle-current evidence, the 1.9 A fault threshold, LED visibility, capacitor effective capacitance, connector assembly/holes, and header availability. Preserve all original electrical targets and pipeline gates; document any revision of prior model-added acceptance criteria, with bench qualification still pending. Supplied supplemental research is evidence, not a claim that this stage browsed or ran its library checks.

args.why: Select a capturable, itemized prototype BOM using the supplied dated manufacturer/distributor research and real local library results. TPS2065CDBVR removes the MIC2544 external-programming-current uncertainty and has a 1 A continuous rating with documented fixed current-limit margin. Preserve the original 500 mA external-load and strictly below 2 mA unloaded-VBUS targets, while explicitly separating conditional prototype selection from unperformed bench qualification.
args.what_changes:
- Create docs/BOM.md with the exact five-column table, one row per fitted refdes, value-only Value cells, exact installed footprints, and every introduced MPN explicitly UNVERIFIED for final release with a source-grounded justification.
- Subject to actual symbol/pin/footprint results, replace U1 with TPS2065CDBVR, tie its active-high EN directly to VBUS_RAW, leave unused FLT open without a pull-up, and remove R3/ILIM_SET intentionally because this device has a fixed current limit. Preserve common protection of both outputs and LED, independent CC resistors, and all original electrical targets.
- Select the supplied exact USB, terminal, header, 0603 resistors/capacitors, and 3 mm through-hole LED; record connector polarity, mechanical correspondence, assembly conditions, and availability risks.
- Update docs/SPEC.md, docs/SUBSYSTEMS.md and affected OpenSpec capabilities consistently. Explicitly revise the prior architecture-stage documentary freeze criterion to permit an UNVERIFIED reviewable prototype BOM with bounded conditional budgets and mandatory qualification before release; do not turn condition-limited evidence into all-temperature guarantees or remove any original software/code gate.
- Reallocate the LED allowance to 0.540 mA to cover resistor tolerance/TCR over the assumed 0-50 C range. Replace the obsolete RSET-current allowance with a sourced, non-overlapping TPS2065C current ledger; retain and clearly label unknown leakage and the unloaded-IQ test-condition gap.
- Itemize dated quantity-100 prices and explicitly uncertain estimates, preserving the strict USD 8 component target. Record decisions/constraints and intentional omissions. Run actual footprint checks and check_drift; leave physical testing and later hardware gates pending.
args.tasks:
- [ ] Read related capability specs and reconcile the supplied research with original requirements.
- [ ] Search installed symbols and obtain real pin maps for every selected symbol.
- [ ] Check every exact BOM footprint and document manufacturer/package correspondence and remaining manufacturing conditions.
- [ ] Write the fixed-format per-refdes BOM, current/threshold/drop calculations, complete cost estimate, source ledger, and qualification conditions.
- [ ] Record the explicit prototype-selection gate revision, U1 replacement/R3 removal, selected parts, current reallocations, and all changed constraints; synchronize SPEC, SUBSYSTEMS and affected capability scenarios.
- [ ] Read back changes, resolve affected-document obligations, run check_drift, and finish only after the actual part-selection gates are satisfied.
